label.en: Keep the unit's clock in sync with Homey

hint.en: The week and holiday schedules run on the unit's clock. When enabled, the clock is set to Homey's time whenever it is more than 2 minutes off, for example after a daylight saving time change.
Do not remove if you use Regulation mode Room or Room S/W.
